N = int(input())
MOD = 10**9 + 7

dpX = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
dpY = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]

for i in range(N, -1, -1):
    for j in range(N, -1, -1):
        valD1 = 0
        valD2 = 0
        if i + 1 <= N:
            maxVal = max(dpX[i + 1][j], dpY[i + 1][j])
            valD2 += maxVal
        valD2 %= MOD
        if j + 1 <= min(i, N):
            maxVal = max(dpX[i][j + 1], dpY[i][j + 1])
            valD2 += maxVal
        valD2 %= MOD

        if i + 1 <= N:
            maxVal = max(dpX[i + 1][j], dpY[i + 1][j])
            valD1 = max(valD1, 1 + valD2 - maxVal + dpY[i + 1][j])
            valD1 %= MOD
        if j + 1 <= min(i, N):
            maxVal = max(dpX[i][j + 1], dpY[i][j + 1])
            valD1 = max(valD1, 1 + valD2 - maxVal + dpY[i][j + 1])
            valD1 %= MOD
        dpX[i][j] = valD1
        dpY[i][j] = valD2

result = max(dpX[0][0], dpY[0][0])
print(result)
